name: LayerSwap
rootCause: The @GoDaddy account for the L2 cross-chain bridge LayerSwap's domain http://layerswap[.]io was compromised. The compromise of the domain led to a phishing site being displayed, resulting in approximately 50 users losing ~$100K worth assets. To address this, Layerswap is refunding the affected users in full plus and an additional 10% as a compensation for the caused inconvenience.

descriptions.text: The @GoDaddy account for the L2 cross-chain bridge LayerSwap's domain http://layerswap[.]io was compromised. The compromise of the domain led to a phishing site being displayed, resulting in approximately 50 users losing ~$100K worth assets. To address this, Layerswap is refunding the affected users in full plus and an additional 10% as a compensation for the caused inconvenience.

LayerSwap’s domain registrar account was compromised on March 20, 2024, leading to a DNS hijack that redirected users to a phishing site. Approximately $100,000 in user assets was stolen. LayerSwap regained control within hours and pledged full refunds and extra compensation. Attackers gained access to LayerSwap’s GoDaddy account and changed DNS records, redirecting users to a phishing site. The registrar credential compromise enabled both domain and email hijacking.
